extraction.Name: Jennie Moeller
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. Recorded Apr. 5, 1920, by Martin Loan & Abstract Co, Martin, S.D.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Bank of Ipswich, Ipswich, So. Dak. for $600.00, recorded Apr. 5, 1920; mortgaged to H. E. Beebe, Ipswich, So. Dak. for $160.00, recorded June 10, 1921; SE1 29-37-36 deeded to G. H. Cherry, Martin, So. Dak. for $2800.00 on July 3, 1922, recorded Aug. 28, 1922
extraction.NOTES: Husband: Joseph H. Moeller. Land description: SE1/4 29-37-36. Records taken from Martin, So. Dak. Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. Two mortgage entries reference Bank of Ipswich on Apr. 5, 1920 (one for $90.00 and one for $600.00, both recorded Apr. 5, 1920).
